excerpt: Choosing between a 3BHK and 4BHK on Dwarka Expressway? Here's how space planning, budget, and layout priorities actually differ between the two.
keyTakeaways: The Extra Room Is a Functional Choice, Not Just Space — A 4BHK's fourth room enables a home office, guest suite, or media room most 3BHKs can't fit.
3BHK Design Leans on Multi-Purpose Rooms — Sofa-cum-bed and murphy bed systems let one room serve two functions.
4BHK Costs ₹30-50 Lakh vs ₹20-32 Lakh for a 3BHK — The gap comes from custom millwork and electrical points in the extra room, not just added area.
Common Area Proportions Shift With Configuration — 4BHK layouts typically allocate more square footage to living/dining relative to bedroom count.
Decide the Fourth Room's Function Early — Before finalising electrical and furniture layout, not after.
contentHtml:
The core interior design difference between a 3BHK and a 4BHK on Dwarka Expressway isn't just one extra bedroom — it's that a 4BHK's additional room gives you a genuine functional choice (home office, guest suite, media room) that most 3BHK layouts don't have room for.

Dwarka Expressway's newer high-rise developments typically offer 3BHK units in the 1,450-1,900 sq ft range and 4BHK units from roughly 2,000 sq ft upward.

The Core Difference: What the Extra Room Actually Buys You

  • Zoning becomes a real decision, not a default — dedicated home office, media/family room, guest suite, or study.
  • Storage planning changes — 4BHK households often fit a dedicated storage/utility zone beyond the kitchen utility area.
  • Common area proportions shift — 4BHK layouts allocate more square footage to living/dining relative to bedroom count.

Space Planning Priorities for a 3BHK

  • Multi-purpose room design (sofa-cum-bed or murphy bed for guest room + home office)
  • Storage efficiency over storage volume (loft units, under-bed storage, vertical kitchen storage)
  • Semi-open kitchen consideration to visually expand common area — see our modular kitchen layout guide for how this plays out by floor plan.

Space Planning Priorities for a 4BHK

  • Deliberate room-function assignment for the fourth room before finalising electrical/furniture layout
  • Distinct living and family zones rather than one combined space
  • En-suite/guest-bathroom planning with slightly higher finish quality

Budget Comparison: 3BHK vs 4BHK Turnkey Interiors on Dwarka Expressway

ConfigurationTypical Carpet AreaFull Turnkey Interior Cost (2026)Typical Timeline
3BHK1,450-1,900 sq ft₹20-32 lakh90-110 days
4BHK2,000-2,800 sq ft₹30-50 lakh100-130 days

The cost difference isn't purely proportional to area — a 4BHK's extra functional room typically adds more cost per sq ft than base bedrooms, given custom millwork and AV/electrical points.

How to Decide Which Configuration Fits Your Household

If you regularly host guests, work from home, or have a growing family needing a study zone, a 4BHK's flexibility is usually worth it. A smaller household prioritising budget and faster turnaround can get most of the same functionality from a well-planned 3BHK.

faqs.question: How much more does a 4BHK interior cost compared to a 3BHK on Dwarka Expressway?
faqs.answer: ₹30-50 lakh vs ₹20-32 lakh, driven by the extra functional room's custom millwork and electrical points, not just added area.

faqs.question: What should I do with the extra room in a 4BHK apartment?
faqs.answer: Decide its function deliberately (home office, guest suite, media room, study) at the design stage rather than leaving it as a generic extra bedroom.

faqs.question: Can a 3BHK room serve as both a guest room and home office?
faqs.answer: Yes — a sofa-cum-bed or murphy bed system lets one room serve both functions.

faqs.question: Is a semi-open kitchen better for a 3BHK or 4BHK on Dwarka Expressway?
faqs.answer: Particularly beneficial in 3BHK layouts to visually expand the living/dining area; 4BHK layouts have more flexibility either way.
